name: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
summary: At the Scarlet Raven Tavern, Chef Grual prepares his signature dish for Darkshire. He asks you to hunt Duskwood wolves for meat while his herbs arrive from Stormwind City.

sections.title: A Dish for Darkshire
sections.body: Darkshire stands isolated among the horrors creeping through Duskwood. Trade caravans seldom reach town, farming has failed, and undead lurk nearby, yet people still need food. At the Scarlet Raven Tavern, Chef Grual turns dangerous forest wolves into hearty skewers. The local soil and timber cannot support delicate crops, so he relies on spices from the capital to make the gamey meat palatable.

sections.title: A Shipment from Stormwind
sections.body: Grual has just received a shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs. Now he needs lean meat from the ferocious wolves stalking Duskwood. The delivery shows how Darkshire remains tied to the wider kingdom. Royal military aid has dwindled, while supply lines between city merchants and outer hamlets barely endure.

faq.answer: Chef Grual is the cook stationed at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. He feeds patrons, locals, and Night Watch members hearty meals made from game hunted in the surrounding woods.

faq.q: Where do you get the Stormwind Seasoning Herbs?
faq.answer: You do not need to fetch the Stormwind Seasoning Herbs. Grual has just received a shipment and needs ten Lean Wolf Flanks from you.

faq.q: Where are the wolves for the wolf flanks found?
faq.answer: Wild wolves roam Duskwood’s dark forests, especially in the groves and pathways just outside Darkshire. Any local wolf yields the lean meat Grual needs.

faq.q: Why does Darkshire need wolf meat for food?
faq.answer: Darkshire’s farmland is ruined and monsters cut it off, making livestock and crops nearly impossible to raise. Locals hunt dangerous wildlife, including wolves prowling beyond town’s borders.

faq.q: Why can't Grual get herbs locally in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Duskwood’s curse has corrupted much of its native plant life, leaving few edible or fragrant cooking herbs. Grual relies on cultivated varieties brought from Stormwind to season his dishes.

faq.q: Does this quest tie into a larger storyline?
faq.answer: This is a standalone local tale, separate from any grand narrative. It shows Darkshire’s self-reliant way of life and its tenuous supply link to Stormwind.

angles.text: Grual’s recipe shows how wilderness hunters make tough predator meat palatable with refined city spices.
The delivery between Darkshire and Stormwind shows how isolated settlements rely on the capital’s markets, even as military garrisons are withheld.
You track Duskwood’s ravenous wolf packs, using your skills to protect the hamlet and keep the tavern’s larder stocked.
